corrected_verdict: PARTIALLY_KNOWN, with more of it known than the checker said. The nu=3 roots-of-unity block, its cancellation of sign-flipped copies, and a minimal-norm characterisation within 3-node solutions are all in Tian (NeurIPS 2025, arXiv 2410.01779). What remains ours: general nu, uniqueness as the equality case of Lemma cost over any number of neurons, and exact L_{2,b} max-margin optimality.
issues:
MISSED ML PRIOR ART. Tian, 'Composing Global Solutions to Reasoning Tasks via Algebraic Objects in Neural Nets', NeurIPS 2025 poster (OpenReview tD7MLq0dbZ, arXiv 2410.01779v4).
- Table 1 and Sec. 5 define u_syn=[w3,w3,w3], w3=e^{2pi i/3}, and z_syn=rho(u_syn)=u^2+u+1: 3 hidden nodes per frequency with cube-root-of-unity phases. It zeroes the sign-flipped sum potentials abar-b-c, a-bbar-c and a-b-cbar (set R_c) and keeps r_kkk.
- Fig. 2 (bottom): 'each frequency has exactly 3 hidden nodes, corresponding to the solution z_syn' when the self-term constraint R_* is dropped.
- Lemma 6: with small L2 regularisation, all order-3 per-frequency solutions satisfying R_c and R_g are [1, a_p w3, b_p w3bar], a_p, b_p = +-1. Eqs. 91-95 give equal magnitudes and phases 2pi/3, 4pi/3 as the minimal-norm optimum. The proof uses 'all cross terms are gone since sum_j w3^j = 0'.
- I checked numerically that Tian's trilinear part equals the paper's nu=3 block table (3/4) cos(theta_a+theta_b-theta_c), up to a trivial sign symmetry.
- The global z_F6 = z_syn * z_nu (6 nodes) handles the quadratic self-terms. Corollary 3 uses d-th roots of unity.
- Tian is not cited anywhere in the paper. The checker's statement 'I found no ML paper that uses the rank-nu separated form' is false at nu=3.

SECONDARY.
- Shutman, Louidor, Tessler, arXiv 2509.06931 (2025): the Hadamard (product) model has rank <=3 per cyclic frequency (Prop. 5.2, type II). So 3 product neurons per frequency suffice. They use the Gauss 3-multiplication trick, not roots of unity, and the construction is not norm-optimal.
- Doshi, He, Das, Gromov, 'Grokking Modular Polynomials' (ICLR 2024 BGPT workshop, arXiv 2406.03495) extends Gromov's random-phase (approximate) cancellation to many-term addition with power activations. It is a contrast citation.

FRAMING ERROR IN THE RECOMMENDED TEXT. Morwani (8 neurons) and Li (2^{2nu-3}) are power-network constructions, which must also cancel self-interaction monomials. The paper itself says the product block does not attain for power networks. '8 or 2^{2nu-3} vs nu' is therefore apples-to-oranges unless the text names the model class. The fair comparison is Tian's: 3 nodes without self-terms, 6 for the full quadratic net.

CONFIRMED CITATIONS all re-verified:
- mohlenkamp2005trig: Crossref metadata correct. Thm 2 and Fig. 1 (alpha = 0, pi/3, 2pi/3, 'amplitude equidistributed') read in the preprint. Rephasing shows the equally spaced cos case matches the block.
- gromov2023grokking: Eqs. 12 and 15, random uniform phases.
- morwani2024feature: App. F.2, 8 neurons per frequency with the listed phase triples.
- li2025nsum: PMLR v258 pp. 523-531, App. E.3 Lemma E.3, 2^{2k-1} neurons per frequency.
- He et al. 2602.16849 Def. 4.1(iii) is also as described.

NO FURTHER HITS: Kunin et al. AGF (polarisation sign pairs only), Kam et al. 2607.13749 (roots of unity used as input encoding), Huang-Li 2511.23443.

REVISED TEXT. Say that for nu=3 the block is Tian's z_syn, and that it is the equally spaced case of the Mohlenkamp-Monzon identity. Contrast with the power-network sign-pattern constructions (Tian 6, Morwani 8, Li 2^{2nu-3}) and with random phases (Gromov, Doshi). Claim only general nu, and uniqueness as the equality case of Lemma cost over any width.

extra_citations.why: Direct ML prior art for the nu=3 block. z_syn = rho(u_syn) is 3 nodes per frequency with cube-root-of-unity phases that cancel the sign-flipped sum potentials (R_c). Lemma 6 and Eqs. 91-95 show the equal-magnitude cube-root configuration is the minimal-norm order-3 solution. The global solution z_F6 (6 nodes) is the quadratic-network analogue. Venue confirmed via OpenReview (tD7MLq0dbZ, 'NeurIPS 2025 poster').

Hadamard (product) model on group words. Prop. 5.2 gives per-frequency tensor rank <=3 for cyclic groups (type-II bsc), via the Gauss three-multiplication trick. This is ML prior art that 3 product neurons per frequency suffice, but it does not use the roots-of-unity form or claim norm optimality. Optional context citation.

Analytic solutions for many-term modular addition with power activations. It cancels unwanted terms only approximately ('random phase approximation', i.i.d. uniform phases), making it the multi-operand contrast alongside Gromov 2023. Optional.
